readiness_metadata.note: M26-B implements domain contracts, port interfaces, versioned schemas, and deterministic codecs. No adapters or runtime.

domain_contracts.description: Pure platform-independent value objects with invariants
domain_contracts.notes: All domain objects reject invalid state at construction. No vendor SDK imports.

port_interfaces.description: Abstract Protocol interfaces for hardware, telemetry, authorization, storage, audit, clock, factory
port_interfaces.notes: 8 port interfaces defined. No concrete implementations.

versioned_schemas.description: 13 versioned JSON Schema documents (v1.0.0) with stable URN identifiers

deterministic_codecs.description: Explicit encode/decode functions with canonical JSON, round-trip tested
deterministic_codecs.notes: NaN and Infinity rejected. Stable enum strings. Sorted keys for hashing.

architecture_enforcement.description: Tests verify no forbidden imports, no import-time side effects
architecture_enforcement.notes: Domain, ports, schemas layers scanned for vendor SDK imports.
